subject: Barrel Rolls and other Hall of Fame Scores
author: ZombieTron
body:
If you want your score to appear on the leaderboards you need to update your profile!

Go to My Account at the top of the page, then click on Edit, then select the last tab "Points on My License"  and enter all of your scores. If we don't believe you we will ask you to verify your score with a pic, or you can send a verification pic to us at:

admin at burnoutaholics.com

changing the at for an @ and removing the spaces. Please include your BurnoutAholics user name in the email.

We only need the shot of your profile page. We will not be able to verify your scores if you only send us seperate pictures of scores (e.g. from todays best). You can use a camera to take the picture, all scores must be readable. Make sure that the attached picture is smaller than 500Kb.

When someone posts a really high score that takes them to the top of a leaderboard we normally tag them as Verified=No. This means that the score will be taken off the leaderboard until you have sent us a screenshot of your score.

Thanks,

ZombieTron
